title: The Double Helix of Productivity: A Comprehensive Framework for Understanding and Mitigating Technostress from Generative AI Agents in the Scientific Workplace

contributions.purpose: 构建生成式AI诱发技术压力的理论框架
contributions.mechanism: 在Ragu-Nathan五维基础上扩展,为GAI情境增设子维度(内容验证过载、算法不透明压力、技能贬值焦虑等)
contributions.evaluation: 定性框架:5大维度(Techno-Overload/Complexity/Insecurity/Invasion/Ambiguity)+若干GAI专属子维度(无实证数据)
contributions.domain: 人机协作/科研工作场所技术压力
contributions.source_quote: Our framework delineates five core dimensions of AI-induced technostress... while introducing novel sub-dimensions specific to generative AI contexts.

contributions.mechanism: 综述式归纳个人/组织/技术三层干预措施
contributions.evaluation: 定性建议:认知重评训练、组织AI政策/署名框架、以透明性与置信指示为核心的AI设计原则(无实证验证)
contributions.source_quote: we identify concrete manifestations of these stressors and propose evidence-based intervention strategies at individual, organizational, and technological levels.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We expand beyond existing technostress models to address the unique challenges posed by autonomous, generative AI systems that blur the boundaries between human and machine cognition.

notes: 非实证类适配问题:纯理论/综述框架,无任何数据、量表验证或实验,四元组evaluation只能填框架维度(定性)。过度声称:摘要/引言称提供"empirically validated measurement tools",但全文无任何实证或量表验证——名不副实。数据红旗(幻影引用):checklist Q4/Q5称"appendices include measurement instruments and protocols"、"measurement instruments... fully described in the appendices",但全文根本无附录=幻影附录引用。checklist Q2 Limitations答[NA]"No, its just theoretical"(自认未讨论局限)。AI参与度:写作[B],自述初稿由AI语言模型生成后人工修订。reject。
